title: Assessing pseudobulk DE adequacy with seny
text: assessAll() chains layers — pseudobulk setup, design/confounding (layer 1), pseudobulk quality (layer 2), variance structure sensitivity (layer 4) — returns one row per comparison. comparison table carries layer-2 cell-quality metrics alongside call. cells_cond_cor correlation log cells-per-sample condition; cells_ratio smaller group median larger; expected_recall share true effects target size test expected detect (mean per-gene power target), drives Adequate / Underpowered call. non-adequate call explains : CD4 T clean (Adequate); CD8 T far fewer cells condition B, cell-count imbalance tracks condition breaks equal-variance assumption (Caution — consider voom sampleWeights dreamlet precision weights); NK high -donor variance modest cell count, genes detectable target effect (Underpowered).
code: res <- assessAll(sce, sample = "donor", group = "condition",                  annotations = "cell_type", targetLFC = 1) #> calcNormFactors has been renamed to normLibSizes #> calcNormFactors has been renamed to normLibSizes #> calcNormFactors has been renamed to normLibSizes cols <- c("cluster", "nA", "nB", "median_cells", "gini_cells", "cells_ratio",           "cells_cond_cor", "n_testable", "expected_recall", "call") knitr::kable(as.data.frame(res)[, cols], digits = 2, row.names = FALSE) d <- as.data.frame(res) for (i in seq_len(nrow(d))) {     cat(d$cluster[i], "->", as.character(d$call[i]), "::", d$reason[i], "\n") } #> CD4T -> Adequate :: adequate  #> CD8T -> Caution :: cell-count imbalance correlated with condition (r -1.00, cutoff 0.50 at 24 samples; consider sample weights)  #> NK -> Underpowered :: underpowered (expected recall 45% at log2FC 1)

Default none. contrasts Optional list length-2 character vectors c(, B) naming group levels compare (B vs ). Default 10. aggregation Either "sum" (counts, negative-binomial model) "mean" (reserved limma path). Default "sum". assayName Name raw-count assay sce. text: named list: cramerV (condition-covariate association comparison flagged Caution), vif (variance inflation factor threshold), sensitivity (expected recall target effect comparison adequately powered; 0.5 matches replication failure defined recall 0.5), minSamples (fewer samples per group Invalid), cellsCondCor (absolute correlation log cells per sample condition cell-count imbalance flagged Caution), cellsCondAlpha (correlation must also exceed critical value level comparison's sample size, chance correlations small designs flagged: cutoff max(cellsCondCor, r_crit(n)), 0.81 6 samples cellsCondCor ~16 samples), minTestable (fewer testable genes Underpowered). layer-2 values, like others, provisional placeholders E1-E8. composition values (see assessComposition()) advisory E5/E6 calibration: compFDR (propeller FDR child's share within parent called shifted), compFrac (share testable genes look DE shift alone comparison flagged Caution) compExplained (share parent DEG's observed log2 fold change predicted shift-change must explain gene attributed composition).

what: Layer 4 (sensitivity): minimum detectable effect and power — estimateSensitivity
title: Layer 4 (sensitivity): minimum detectable effect and power — estimateSensitivity
text: variance fits (estimateVariance()), computes analytic standard error two-group log2 fold-change contrast per gene (SE^2 = 1/sum_A w + 1/sum_B w, w = 1/(1/mu + phi), phi dispersion condition design), minimum detectable effect target power FDR, power primary target effect. Summarises comparison's expected recall targetLFC: mean per-gene power target testable genes, .e. share true effects size test expected detect spread like testable genes. callComparisons() calls comparison Adequate expected recall reaches defaultThresholds()$sensitivity (0.5). OneK1K known injected effects tracked observed recall per comparison (slope 1.0), whereas sensitivity fraction (share genes whose MDE clears target target power, still reported) -predicts (E4c). Uncalibrated MVP (calibrate = FALSE).

title: Layer 4 (sensitivity): minimum detectable effect and power — estimateSensitivity
text: variance list returned estimateVariance(). targetLFC Primary target absolute log2 fold-change call. Default 1. power Target power. Default 0.8. fdr Target FDR. Default 0.05. pi1 Fraction true positives maps FDR per-gene threshold: "discoveries" (default) estimates per comparison fraction genes comparison's DE test calls fdr; number fixes every comparison (falls back 0.05 comparison whose fit p-values). alphaFixed Optional fixed per-gene significance level. NULL (default) uses pi1-mapped level alone; number makes call use stricter two (larger MDE). calibrate Reserved; must FALSE MVP.

title: Layer 4 (sensitivity): minimum detectable effect and power — estimateSensitivity
text: FDR target mapped per-gene significance level fraction true positives pi1 (Jung 2005), capped fdr (BH never tests gene FDR level). BH's realised per-gene threshold scales fraction genes calls, fixed pi1 suits every contrast: sparse contrast (male vs female blood, realised threshold ~1e-4) makes fixed 5% optimistic, dense one makes conservative. default (pi1 = "discoveries") comparison uses fraction BH discoveries, R / m DE test chosen method fdr (floored 1 / m), power evaluated threshold BH actually uses .
